title: The positive Kummer equation of normalized Chern data
statement: Fix a prime ell, a scheme T, ring diagrams R,A on its pro-etale site, a morphism phi between their sequence-site ring objects, Chern data c [def-sp-tower-class-chern], and a morphism q from the R coefficient module to restriction of the A coefficient module. If ChernData.Normalized(c,q), then c.reduction.model.targetNormalization(Kummer(c),c.rootIso,c.rootForget) [def-sp-tower-class-reduction]. This retains the positive Kummer boundary and its shifts. The predicate is shared by the explicit definition ChernData.rootNormalized, with exactly this target-normalization formula.

theorem chern_integral_target_normalization
    (T : Scheme.{u})
    (R A : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : SemilinearSections.systemRing.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
        (fun n ↦ R.obj (op n)) (fun n ↦ R.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) ⟶
      SemilinearSections.systemRing.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
        (fun n ↦ A.obj (op n)) (fun n ↦ A.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op))
    (c : ChernData l T R A φ)
    (q : coefficient T R ⟶ (SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1} φ).obj
      (coefficient T A)) (n : ChernData.Normalized l T R A φ c q) :
    c.rootNormalized l T R A φ
